purpose: Map weak assessment signals to focused review routes. The queue should recommend evidence and reasoning practice, not generic reading.

business_goal.label: Business goal
business_goal.review_question: Can you state the business outcome before SAP detail?

routes.label: Sales Process Atlas
routes.why: Practice business variants before configuration detail.

routes.label: Procurement Decision Map
routes.why: Connect demand, sourcing, receipt, invoice, and settlement to business intent.

routes.label: Business AI
routes.why: Start AI discussion from a defined business job and measurable outcome.

owner.label: Owner
owner.review_question: Can you name which component or team owns the decision and durable state?

routes.label: Integration Architecture
routes.why: Separate source-of-truth ownership from transport technology.

routes.label: Master Data Governance
routes.why: Review governance ownership, change process, and distribution responsibility.

routes.label: Deployment Models
routes.why: Practice how deployment choice changes ownership and extension boundaries.

process_flow.label: Process flow
process_flow.review_question: Can you trace the requirement through the main documents, events, and states?

routes.label: Sales Process Atlas
routes.why: Compare end-to-end O2C and special process branches.

routes.label: Production Planning & Execution
routes.why: Trace demand through MRP, order execution, goods receipt, and settlement.

routes.label: Transportation Management
routes.why: Trace transport demand, planning, execution, charges, and settlement.

decision_logic.label: Decision logic
decision_logic.review_question: Can you identify the master data, configuration, determination, or control that creates the state?

routes.label: Sales Order Decision Map
routes.why: Review determination and order control layers.

routes.label: Pricing
routes.why: Practice condition technique, calculation, and diagnostic ownership.

routes.label: Inventory Management
routes.why: Review movement semantics, stock state, valuation, and account impact.

boundary.label: Boundary
boundary.review_question: Can you explain where responsibility crosses module, system, company, or execution layer?

routes.label: Integration Operations & Recovery
routes.why: Practice message identity, commit state, retry, replay, and reconciliation boundaries.

routes.label: Extended Warehouse Management
routes.why: Separate ERP inventory ownership from warehouse execution.

routes.label: MDG Interfaces
routes.why: Review governance and downstream distribution boundaries.

failure_and_evidence.label: Failure and evidence
failure_and_evidence.review_question: Can you prove the first wrong decision instead of repairing the final symptom?

routes.label: Sales Diagnostic Casebook
routes.why: Practice symptom-first hypotheses and proof of fix.

routes.label: Integration Operations & Recovery
routes.why: Separate technical delivery status from business completion.

routes.label: Cross-Process Lead Cases
routes.why: Practice evidence across several SAP domains.

trade_off.label: Trade-off
trade_off.review_question: Can you explain why this design is suitable, what it costs, and what condition would change it?

routes.label: SAP Development Choices
routes.why: Compare clean-core, ABAP, RAP, CAP, and side-by-side choices.

routes.label: Deployment Models
routes.why: Practice design limits across Public Cloud, Private Cloud, and On-Premise.

routes.label: AI Ready Architecture
routes.why: Review authority, reliability, security, and operating-model trade-offs.

queue_rule: Rank weak reasoning dimensions first, then weak tracks. Prefer one focused route with a clear review question over a long reading list. Re-run a related assessment case after review.
